_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROBABILITY AND IMPACT MATRIX' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.08.04.

f01_Matrix_Grid_Dimensions_and_Scaling.label: Matrix Grid Dimensions and Scaling
f01_Matrix_Grid_Dimensions_and_Scaling.guidance: Description of the matrix layout (e.g., 5x5 grid) and mathematical scoring formula.

f02_Risk_Tolerance_and_Severity_Bands.label: Risk Tolerance and Severity Bands
f02_Risk_Tolerance_and_Severity_Bands.guidance: Definition of risk severity bands: High (Red), Medium (Yellow), and Low (Green).

f03_Threat_Evaluation_Grid_Mapping.label: Threat Evaluation Grid Mapping
f03_Threat_Evaluation_Grid_Mapping.guidance: The calibrated scoring values and color-coded zones for negative risk threats.

f04_Opportunity_Evaluation_Grid_Mapping.label: Opportunity Evaluation Grid Mapping
f04_Opportunity_Evaluation_Grid_Mapping.guidance: The calibrated scoring values and color-coded zones for positive project opportunities.

f05_Mandatory_Treatment_Thresholds.label: Mandatory Treatment Thresholds
f05_Mandatory_Treatment_Thresholds.guidance: Thresholds requiring mandatory immediate mitigation and dedicated contingency funding.

f06_Executive_Escalation_Protocols.label: Executive Escalation Protocols
f06_Executive_Escalation_Protocols.guidance: Protocols governing when high-severity risks must be escalated to the Executive Sponsor or PMO.
